# DabWave Hue Ramps — Proposed Catalog

**Status: Proposed (DAB-016).** Not approved. Generated by
`scripts/hue-catalog.mjs`; do not consume in a site until ratified.

Thirteen steps share the ratified gray step names. Each hue has a fixed H
and a fixed anchor step chosen for its vivid lightness; the chroma curve
peaks at that anchor, so warm hues stay warm instead of turning muddy.
The L ladder is shared; steps 0 and 1000 are white and black.

| Step | L |
|---:|---:|
| 0 | 1.000 |
| 50 | 0.970 |
| 100 | 0.940 |
| 200 | 0.880 |
| 300 | 0.810 |

| 500 | 0.640 |
